# Level import components

- Pushmo payload parsing, RGB interoperability data, conversion and scan fallbacks are adapted from the independently written `pushmo-qr-decoder` project. Copyright (c) 2026 pushmo-qr-decoder contributors, MIT.
- jsQR 1.4.0: Copyright 2017 Cosmo Wolfe and contributors, Apache-2.0. Only its distribution wrapper was adapted to ES modules; the scanning implementation is unchanged.
- The complete required notices and licenses ship in `public/import-licenses.txt` (deployed as `import-licenses.txt`).
- The 184-entry RGB table is factual interoperability data. No Nintendo artwork, sprites, fonts, reference cards or earlier third-party parser implementation is included.
